title: AlignmentObject
description:
An intangible item that describes an alignment between a learning resource and a node in an educational framework.
Should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

alignmentType.title: Alignment Type
alignmentType.description: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.

educationalFramework.title: Educational Framework
educationalFramework.description: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

targetDescription.title: Target Description
targetDescription.description: The description of a node in an established educational framework.

targetName.title: Target Name
targetName.description: The name of a node in an established educational framework.

targetUrl.title: Target Url
targetUrl.description: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.
